description: PIN. scalaVersion is held at 2.9.0-1 because com.digitaldoodles:rex
-- the library this repository exists to exercise -- is only
cross-published for Scala 2.9.0-1 and 2.8.1. There is no rex_2.9.3:
https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/com/digitaldoodles/rex_2.9.3/ returns
404, while rex_2.9.0-1 returns 200.
This is not theoretical. Renovate proposed scalaVersion 2.9.0-1 ->
2.9.3 and it was merged, which silently broke dependency resolution:
`%%` then looks for rex_2.9.3, which does not exist. The repository has
no CI (no .github/workflows at all), so nothing reported the breakage.
Moving off 2.9.0-1 means dropping rex or cross-building it first, so it
is a decision about the project, not a dependency bump.
PIN. specs2-scalaz-core is held at 6.0.RC2 because that is the only
version published for the _2.9.0-1 suffix. 6.0.1 exists only for other
cross-builds (_2.9.0, _2.9.3, _2.10.x), so Renovate's offer of 6.0.1
(PR #8) does not resolve here.
PIN. rex is held at 0.7.0.1, the newest version of the _2.9.0-1
cross-build. Renovate offered 0.701 (PR #8/#9), but that is not a newer
release -- it is the latest version of the SEPARATE _2.8.1 cross-build.
Maven Central lists rex_2.9.0-1 -> 0.7.0.1 and rex_2.8.1 -> 0.701, and
Renovate's version ordering reads 0.701 as greater than 0.7.0.1.
